div.div:
REFUTED + REFINED → DRAFT (loop)
The spike's most-traveled feedback edge.
Refuted hypotheses become next cycle's
starting point — never disappear without trace.

div.div:
ARTIFACT ANNOTATION RULE
When a state transitions, the related artifact (PRD, mockup, ADR) gets a hypothesis-outcome annotation:
status: CONFIRMED | REFUTED | PARTIAL
date:
evidence:
Artifacts are NEVER silently updated. The annotation IS the audit trail.
